beats.label: The harness so far
beats.cue: “So far in this series…” Recap intelligence, the harness, and ways to interact with the world.

beats.label: Reveal Context
beats.cue: “For months now, AI agents have been marketed as teammates…” Hold here through “the next component of the harness: Context.”

beats.label: Crumple and toss
beats.cue: Turn the page before “Are you surprised that context is part of the harness…?”

beats.label: Pre-training
beats.cue: “In nugget 3, we talked about the model lifecycle…” Pre-training gives the model its general capabilities.

beats.label: Post-training
beats.cue: “Some labs post-train models before release…” Specialized training remains different from this conversation’s context.

beats.label: Release day
beats.cue: “On day one…” The trained model is released.

beats.label: To work; the factory closes
beats.cue: “The rest is up to the harness.” The finished engine goes to work; its training factory closes.

beats.label: Open the agent chat
beats.cue: “Context shows up in a couple different forms.” Introduce the familiar chat surface.

beats.label: Say hello
beats.cue: “The harness generally has a baseline amount of context baked in…” The user asks who the agent is.

beats.label: The agent knows its role
beats.cue: The agent introduces itself, then asks who you are. Hold through the explanation of separate conversation windows.

beats.label: Sketch the classroom
beats.cue: “Imagine you’re in a room with your agent…” Draw the edges of the context window.

beats.label: Paint in the room
beats.cue: The room has a fixed size. Hold through the explanation of adding information and using up space.

beats.label: The user and agent walk in
beats.cue: “The room is your context window. You and your agent walk in…” The agent carries its role-instruction pamphlet.

beats.label: Introduce yourself
beats.cue: “So the first thing you might do is introduce yourself…” Role, team, work, and preferences become small cubes.

beats.label: Ask the agent to research you
beats.cue: “A different way for the agent to learn about you…” Include the Confluence link; the prompt also takes space.

beats.label: MCP tools take up space
beats.cue: “It calls the Rovo MCP server…” Rovo, Gmail, and Calendar tool definitions enter before retrieved information.

beats.label: Research results arrive
beats.cue: “Then comes the actual information it pulls back in.” Pages, email, and calendar information enter the room.

beats.label: The initial context is assembled
beats.cue: “All of a sudden, your room is filling up…” The approved small pile leaves space for later work.

beats.label: The UNC work request
beats.cue: “But we persevere…” Read two weeks of UNC Slack activity, identify workstreams, and create a Confluence tracking page.
beats.note: Narration pause on the filled room. A dedicated UNC Slack-to-Confluence visual has not been built.

beats.label: Load copies into the mine cart
beats.cue: “You give your agent the prompt…” The harness gathers the relevant context and loads copies with the prompt.

beats.label: Take context to the model
beats.cue: “This is one of the key areas where the model as a brain analogy falls apart…” Reveal the separate model and continuous track.

beats.label: The model works and replies
beats.cue: “The model is sitting in its own little world…” The machine processes the load; its reply returns to the room.

beats.label: Send context again on the next turn
beats.cue: “The harness has to send all the relevant context… with each prompt.” Include the earlier reply in the next load.

beats.label: Hi, I’m Dory
beats.cue: “It might as well be Dory from Finding Nemo…” Reintroduce yourself and resend what the model needs.

beats.label: Inference costs tokens
beats.cue: “Going back to the model lifecycle… inference costs tokens.” Trigger coins here, after Dory.

beats.label: Context versus cost
beats.cue: “Seems like you’re stuck between a rock and a hard place…” Balance useful context with cost and the risk of an unhelpful answer.
beats.note: Narration pause on the final view; no separate cost-versus-quality visual has been built.

beats.label: Next nugget
beats.cue: “In the next nugget…” Tease growing context and the mechanisms for managing it.
beats.note: Closing hold. Context overflow is reserved for the next nugget.
